test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Bundu Khan was a _________ player of Delhi gharana.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarangi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **sarangi** is renowned for its ability to convey a wide range of emotions through its expressive tone and bowing techniques.
 
• **Bundu Khan **was a renowned sarangi player, a bowed string instrument known for its expressive and soulful sound.
 
• He belonged to the **Delhi gharana**, a prestigious school of **Hindustani classical music**.
 
• **Bundu Khan's **contributions to the **sarangi** and the** Delhi gharana **have left a lasting impact on Indian classical music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 Famous Players of Other Instruments:

**1. Sarod:**

 
• Ustad Amjad Ali Khan: Widely regarded as the "Maestro of the Sarod," he has elevated the sarod to international acclaim. 
 
• Ustad Buddhadeb Chatterjee: He has redefined the boundaries of sarod playing with his innovative techniques and emotional intensity.

**2. Flute:**

 
• Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia: Considered one of the greatest flute virtuosos of Indian classical music.

**3. Santoor:**

 
• Pandit Shiv Kumar Sharma: He popularized the santoor as a prominent classical instrument.
 
• Ustad Naseeruddin Shah: A versatile musician known for his expertise on the santoor, his music is characterized by its technical brilliance.
